name: trialdiff-evidence-records
title: TrialDiff Evidence Records for ClinicalTrials.gov amendment history
description: Deterministic, hash-verifiable, claim-bounded Evidence Records derived from public ClinicalTrials.gov record-version history, plus the full (failed) severity-calibration paper trail. Severity/triage labels are deterministic, reproducible, uncalibrated metadata — not validated review priority and not findings of wrongdoing. See ERRATA.md for known defects.
